title: 1. The Restaurant Analogy (The Event Loop)
diagram:
sequenceDiagram participant Main as Main Thread (Waiter) participant API as Background API (Kitchen) participant EventLoop as Event Loop (Bell) Main->>API: 1. Fetch Data (Order Food) Note over Main: 2. Continues executing other code
(Serves other tables) API-->>EventLoop: 3. Data is ready (Rings bell) EventLoop-->>Main: 4. Promise Resolves (Picks up food)

title: 3. Async / Await
diagram:
sequenceDiagram participant Stack as Call Stack participant WebAPI as Web APIs (Network) participant Queue as Callback Queue Stack->>WebAPI: Encounter `await fetch()` (Offload task) Note over Stack: Function execution yields!
(Stack is freed) WebAPI-->>Queue: Network response arrives Queue-->>Stack: Event Loop pushes
callback to Stack Note over Stack: Function execution resumes!

title: The Magic of the `use` Callback
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant F as Fixture
    participant T as Test Code
    
    F->>F: 1. Setup (Login, Navigate, Seed Data)
    F->>T: 2. await use(loginPage)
    Note over F: Fixture Execution PAUSED
    Note over T: 3. TEST RUNS AND FINISHES
    T-->>F: 4. Test execution complete
    Note over F: Fixture Execution RESUMES
    F->>F: 5. Teardown (Logout, Delete Data)

title: The E-Sign Workflow (Standard)
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as Reviewer
    participant UI as Web Portal
    participant DB as System / Audit Trail
    
    User->>UI: Open Document
    UI->>DB: Fetch Document State
    DB-->>UI: State: Pending Review
    User->>UI: Enter Reason + Password + Comment
    UI->>DB: Submit E-Signature Payload
    
    rect rgb(30, 41, 59)
        note right of DB: 21 CFR Part 11 Validation
        DB->>DB: Verify Password Credentials
        DB->>DB: Check Document Integrity Hash
        DB->>DB: Append Server-Side Timestamp
    end
    
    DB-->>UI: Signature Accepted
    DB->>DB: Lock Audit Trail Record (Immutable)
    UI-->>User: Show Document as 'Approved'
